description: Who every external or off-box agent is, how Summer reaches it, what it is for, and whether its terms allow automated use. Static facts only: runtime state (current assignment, last heartbeat, busy-time share) is derived by Summer from the mesh heartbeat and the dispatch ledger and is never hand-edited here. Joins by id: agents[].identityId -> canon/agent-identities.json, agents[].capacityProviderId -> ops/registry/capacity.json providers (plan, price, quota policy live there, not here). Metadata only: no tokens, no addresses. Anything not read from a primary source is verified.level=unverified.

tosVerdicts.allowed: The vendor documents this route for this use (primary source cited in tos.basis).
tosVerdicts.allowed-by-design: We assign tasks through the agent's own interface or our own protocol the way the product is meant to be used; vendor terms were not read for automated use.
tosVerdicts.conditional: Permitted only under the stated condition; Summer must satisfy it before dispatch.
tosVerdicts.restricted: Driving it works but may breach consumer terms (UI automation of a consumer app). Do not add new dependence; move to a supported route.
tosVerdicts.forbidden: Terms forbid this server automation. Never dispatch.
tosVerdicts.unverified: No terms were read. Treated as not dispatchable until a verdict is recorded.

workloads.label: Dogfood the golden path
workloads.mission: Walk signup, claim and first value on the Launch project's certified path with the canary accounts; report every dead end, console error, wrong copy or layout shift with exact repro steps and a screenshot reference.

workloads.label: QA sweep beyond the tests
workloads.mission: Exploratory QA of the most recently merged user-facing changes on staging; find bugs the test suite misses and report repro steps.

workloads.label: Independent PR review
workloads.mission: Review the named open pull requests read-only for correctness, security and regressions. Return a verdict and findings per PR with file and line. Do not push, comment or merge.

workloads.label: Prospect research and outreach drafts
workloads.mission: Find qualified prospects for the Launch project's ICP, with source links, and write DRAFT outreach per prospect. Drafts only: nothing is sent, posted or messaged to a real person.

workloads.label: Backlog dedupe and reorder proposals
workloads.mission: Read the agent-ready backlog; propose duplicate sets, stale items to close and a re-ordering by value per hour. Proposals only: no issue is changed.

workloads.label: Research brief
workloads.mission: Answer the named question with sources and a recommendation. Use the research router; do not call paid search providers directly.

workloads.label: Strategy review
workloads.mission: Challenge the current Launch plan against YC activation-first doctrine; return the three highest-leverage changes with evidence.

agents.label: Hyperagent

route.executor: Mac or Gem `hyperagent execute` (OAuth token at ~/.config/hyperagent/mcp-oauth.json, mode 0600) running a task it picks up from the mesh. The token is not copied to Vercel.
route.note: Account-level OAuth MCP: start a thread, follow the run, read results (skills/hyperagent/SKILL.md).

agents.capabilitySource: skills/hyperagent/SKILL.md and the capacity registry (many models on credits).

limits.note: Spend the credits before they expire; pace by balance over days left (capacity registry). `hyperagent models --json` lists only GLM 5.3 Flash, GLM 5.3 and astra: Opus 5.5 is not selectable (2026-10-28).

cost.note: Founding 500, $200/year; credits given, not bought, expire 2027-06-01.

box.notes: Hosted agent sandboxes; per-agent machine access not recorded.

tos.basis: Hyperagent publishes the MCP server as the inbound route for starting and following agent threads (hyperagent.com docs, mcp-server page, cited in skills/hyperagent/SKILL.md).

verified.evidence: Endpoint answers 401 with an OAuth resource_metadata challenge and scopes threads:read threads:write approvals:read approvals:write.
